claims.summary: The origin assigns liability for electioneering communications to the sponsor, not the disseminating medium, except when the medium strips disclosures or alters content into synthetic media.
The origin states that no interactive computer service provider or user is treated as publisher or speaker of another's content, except as allowed under its liability subsection.
The descendant defines consent, coerced consent (fraud, duress, incapacity, exploiting immigration status, etc.), computer, covered platform, and covered platform operator.
The descendant defines intimate visual depiction, pornographic image, sexually explicit conduct, user, and visual depiction, focused on platforms hosting pornographic images.
